en: Colorized vintage postcard view of a calm river scene. In the foreground a small ferry boat with several people and a ferryman stands on the water. In the background a rural riverbank with a path leading up to a modest building with a red roof and large tree beside it, with fields and scattered houses further back. The sky is lightly clouded. German text is printed at the top of the image.
